<ins>Restorative Qi-Penetrating Powder (復元通氣散)</ins>
Saussurea (木香), fennel (茴香, stir-fried), green tangerine peel (青皮, skin removed), pangolin (穿山甲, parched with suet), tangerine peel (陳皮), angelica dahurica (白芷), licorice (甘草), rhaponticum (漏蘆), fritillaria (貝母, each equal parts)
Above, grind into powder; take one to two qian per dose, mixed with warm wine.
